items.text: Commanders QB Jayden Daniels (elbow) will not go on IR; week-to-week after imaging/specialists, aiming return ASAP but OUT this week vs SEA.
items.why: Consensus after evals; positive long-term but ruled out weekend.
items.implication: Mariota starts; McLaurin still viable but matchup-dependent.

items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua (hip) did not practice for the second straight day; McVay says not making great progress and status for Sunday vs DEN in doubt.
items.why: Second consecutive DNP; coach candid on limited progress.
items.implication: Likely miss elevates Davante Adams to clear WR1; monitor Friday report.
items.opportunity: Adams routes/targets spike without him historically.

items.text: Texans WR Nico Collins (hamstring) DNP second straight day; reports indicate not expected to play vs IND.
items.why: Consecutive DNPs; beat/insider expectation of absence.
items.implication: Schultz and others absorb targets; Collins stash ROS.
items.opportunity: Schultz 30% routes/28% share last week without him.

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers (hamstring) DNP second straight practice; looking like miss vs DAL in Brazil.
items.implication: Bateman/others elevated; Flowers day-to-day but risk high.

items.text: Packers first game without Jayden Reed: Christian Watson 45 routes, Matthew Golden 44 on 55 Love dropbacks. Watson+Golden 48% of Love targets so far.
items.why: TNF route data post-Reed neck/back absence.

items.text: Raiders TE Brock Bowers (knee) expected to return Week 3 vs NO after limited practices; good chance/active track.
items.why: Consecutive limited sessions post-meniscus; Rapoport expect language.
items.implication: Elite TE1 if active; Mayer role shrinks.

items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley (stinger) practiced after good MRI; expects to play Monday vs CHI.
items.implication: Full workload likely; handcuffs less urgent.

items.text: Loves Dalton Schultz @ IND: 28% team target share last week sans Collins, targeted 30% of routes; Colts allow 4th-most TE yards.
items.implication: Start Schultz as TE1/stream while Collins out.

items.text: Loves Christian Watson vs ATL: WR8 utilization, 38% RZ target share; WR9 PPG since W11 last year.
items.why: Strong utilization + recent efficiency; Reed absence bonus.

items.text: Davante Adams ran 142 routes without Nacua as Ram, targeted on 42%; produced 8-195-2 vs NYG and prior big game. Clear WR1 if Nacua out again.
items.why: Route/target share data + recent production in absence.
items.implication: Start Adams as WR1 confidently if Nacua ruled out.

items.text: Kyle Pitts only 63% route rate, 8% target share (6 targets/3 games). Historical TPRR 33% with London off, 17% on. Penix health key for revival.
items.why: Season-long low routes/share; London presence suppresses.
items.implication: Pitts fade unless London limited; London strong with Penix.
items.opportunity: London 35% share/97 ypg historical with Penix.

items.text: Loves Derrick Henry vs DAL (Brazil): highest RB rush prop 88.5; Dallas 30th rush D allowing 173.5 ypg.
items.opportunity: Workhorse carries vs weak run D.

items.text: Loves Chris Olave vs LV: double-digit targets both games, 14.8 aDOT, 53% air yards; LV allows league-high 18.7 ypr to WRs.
items.why: Volume + deep threat vs soft secondary.

items.text: Hates Terry McLaurin vs SEA: SEA fewest WR fantasy pts, 7.9 ypr allowed; WAS lowest implied total 17. Tough all around even with Mariota history.
items.why: Brutal matchup + low team total post-Daniels OUT.
items.implication: Sit if better options; Mariota bump insufficient.
items.opportunity: Historical Mariota share positive but overridden.
items.conflict: Prior Mariota games solid but matchup tanks.
